title: Internal terms
description: Patterns that mark internal text, which public output must never contain (packages/naive/src/engine/check-leaks.mjs). Naive's own list is packages/naive/src/engine/internal-terms.json; a venture's founder edits its own at <venture>/governance/internal-terms.json, for unannounced codenames and internal jargon. A pattern with severity warn is reported without failing, for a term whose status a person has not decided yet.

regex.description: A JavaScript regular expression, matched with the g flag

until.description: For a codename: what lifts it, such as the announcement
